nodes.label: Serving API
nodes.description: Accepts inference requests, validates request shape, loads the active model version, runs inference, and returns responses with latency and version metadata.

nodes.label: Inference engine
nodes.description: Executes loaded model versions against validated requests, enforcing resource limits and returning scored outputs to the Serving API.

nodes.label: Model release service
nodes.description: Curates versioned candidate models with hostile traces, runs offline evaluation, records reviewed immutable releases, and controls canary, promotion, rollback, and recorded outcomes.

nodes.label: Model artifact store
nodes.description: Durably stores immutable versioned model artifacts, evaluation evidence, and release records with provenance for each promoted or rolled-back version.

nodes.label: Metrics and logs store
nodes.description: Retains correlated serving metrics, request traces, errors, and release outcome logs for audit and operational analysis.

nodes.label: Serving Monitor
nodes.description: Collects serving latency, error rates, and per-version quality signals, raises alerts on regressions, and reports canary health to operators.

nodes.label: Regression analyzer
nodes.description: Correlates Serving Monitor regression alerts with the active model version and canary window, then issues a version-scoped rollback recommendation with supporting evidence to the Model release service.

baseline.title: Production model-serving stack with release management and monitoring
assumptions: Models are served behind an inference API; no external writes to third-party systems are owned by this stack.
The Model release service owns offline-evaluated, human-approved model releases with canary, promotion, and rollback.
No factual retrieval or RAG path is declared; monitoring reuses only operational metrics and logs.

nodes.description: Accepts inference requests, validates request shape, loads the active model version, runs inference, and returns responses with latency and version metadata.

nodes.label: Inference engine
nodes.description: Executes loaded model versions against validated requests, enforcing resource limits and returning scored outputs to the Serving API.

nodes.label: Model release service
nodes.description: Curates versioned candidate models with hostile traces, runs offline evaluation, records reviewed immutable releases, and controls canary, promotion, rollback, and recorded outcomes.

nodes.label: Model artifact store
nodes.description: Durably stores immutable versioned model artifacts, evaluation evidence, and release records with provenance for each promoted or rolled-back version.

nodes.label: Metrics and logs store
nodes.description: Retains correlated serving metrics, request traces, errors, and release outcome logs for audit and operational analysis.

nodes.label: Serving Monitor
nodes.description: Collects serving latency, error rates, and per-version quality signals, raises alerts on regressions, and reports canary health to operators.

nodes.label: Regression analyzer
nodes.description: Correlates Serving Monitor regression alerts with the active model version and canary window, then issues a version-scoped rollback recommendation with supporting evidence to the Model release service.

nodes.label: Request admission and retry handler
nodes.description: Caps concurrent inference per model version, sheds excess load with a busy error, retries transient engine failures within a bounded budget, and returns typed errors.

nodes.label: Version activation controller
nodes.description: Applies deploy commands as loading, active, draining, or retired transitions under a per-target fencing lock, replays duplicate operation IDs, and confirms or rejects with reason.

nodes.label: Release state machine
nodes.description: Authoritatively owns each release's lifecycle state per serving target, rejecting illegal or stale transitions through optimistic version checks on concurrent updates.

nodes.label: Deployment operation executor
nodes.description: Sends canary, promote, or rollback commands with a durable operation ID, retries with bounded backoff, reads back the loaded version when unsure, and escalates if unknown.

nodes.label: Rollback recommendation intake
nodes.description: Deduplicates rollback recommendations by version and canary window, checks them against current release state, and accepts or declines each with a recorded reason.
